prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Extend `add` with optional `--due YYYY-MM-DD` validation and add a `due` command requiring `--on-or-before YYYY-MM-DD`, with optional `--include-completed` and `--json`. The report must exclude tasks without due dates, default to pending tasks, sort by due date then numeric ID, and label items before the supplied date as overdue without depending on the machine clock. Existing stored tasks without a due date must remain compatible. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/due.txt` and integrate it so non-JSON due reports display the banner before results, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `DUE`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

+function ConvertTo-TaskForgeDate {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Value,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$OptionName
+    )
+
+    $parsed = [datetime]::MinValue
+    $ok = [datetime]::TryParseExact(
+        $Value,
+        'yyyy-MM-dd',
+        [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture,
+        [System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::None,
+        [ref]$parsed)
+    if (-not $ok) {
+        throw "--$OptionName must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format."
+    }
+    return $parsed.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
+}

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$script:assertions = 0

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    $script:assertions++
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'
    Assert-True ($help.Output.Contains('due --on-or-before')) 'help should document the due command'

    # --- due feature ---
    $bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/due.txt'
    $bannerText = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bannerPath) {
        (Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath -Raw).TrimEnd("`r", "`n")
    }
    else { '' }
    $dueData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'due.json'

    $addDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Alpha', '--due', '2026-08-01', '--data-file', $dueData, '--json')
    Assert-True ($addDue.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add with --due should succeed'
    Assert-True (($addDue.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).due -eq '2026-08-01') 'add should persist the due date'

    $badDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Bad', '--due', '2026-13-40', '--data-file', $dueData)
    Assert-True ($badDue.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add with an invalid --due should fail'

    $addEarly = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Bravo', '--due', '2026-07-01', '--data-file', $dueData, '--json')
    Assert-True ($addEarly.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add second dated task should succeed'
    $earlyId = ($addEarly.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).id

    $addNoDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'NoDue', '--data-file', $dueData, '--json')
    Assert-True (($addNoDue.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).due -eq '') 'task added without --due should store an empty due'

    Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', "$earlyId", '--data-file', $dueData, '--json') | Out-Null

    $dueMissing = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--data-file', $dueData)
    Assert-True ($dueMissing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'due without --on-or-before should fail'

    $dueJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-08-01', '--data-file', $dueData, '--json')
    Assert-True ($dueJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'due should succeed'
    $dueItems = @($dueJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($dueItems.Count -eq 1) 'due should default to pending dated tasks and exclude undated tasks'
    Assert-True ($dueItems[0].title -eq 'Alpha' -and $dueItems[0].overdue -eq $false) 'a task due on the reference date is not overdue'
    Assert-True ($dueJson.Output.Trim().StartsWith('[')) 'json due output should be banner-free JSON'
    Assert-True (($bannerText -eq '') -or (-not $dueJson.Output.Contains($bannerText))) 'json due output should not include the banner'

    $dueAll = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-08-01', '--include-completed', '--data-file', $dueData, '--json')
    $allItems = @($dueAll.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($allItems.Count -eq 2) '--include-completed should include completed dated tasks'
    Assert-True ($allItems[0].title -eq 'Bravo' -and $allItems[1].title -eq 'Alpha') 'due should sort by due date then id'
    Assert-True ($allItems[0].overdue -eq $true -and $allItems[1].overdue -eq $false) 'items before the on-or-before date are overdue regardless of the clock'

    $dueBound = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-07-15', '--include-completed', '--data-file', $dueData, '--json')
    $boundItems = @($dueBound.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($boundItems.Count -eq 1 -and $boundItems[0].title -eq 'Bravo') 'due should exclude tasks after the on-or-before date'

    $dueText = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-08-01', '--data-file', $dueData)
    Assert-True (($bannerText -eq '') -or $dueText.Output.StartsWith($bannerText)) 'non-json due output should show the banner before results'
    Assert-True ($dueText.Output.Contains('[DUE] #1 2026-08-01 Alpha')) 'non-json due output should list results after the banner'

    # --- backward compatibility with tasks stored without a due field ---
    $legacyData = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'legacy.json'
    '[{"id":1,"title":"Legacy","description":"","status":"pending","createdAt":"2026-01-01T00:00:00.0000000+00:00"}]' |
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $legacyData -Encoding utf8
    $legacyList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $legacyData, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and @($legacyList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'legacy task without a due field should remain listable'
    $legacyDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2030-01-01', '--include-completed', '--data-file', $legacyData, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyDue.ExitCode -eq 0 -and @($legacyDue.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 0) 'due should exclude legacy tasks that have no due date'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: $script:assertions fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
